title: Church funeral service, viewing the body and dress
summary: Order of a funeral service: viewing the body, half lid, flowers, how the body is dressed, and whether Masons hire bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, let's see. Back to what goes on in the church. You got offerings, singing, and the preachers get up and preach.
Yeah, yeah.
And then what else happens?

They preach and then when they finish everything, they finish the day, the collection and everything, and then the preacher get up and then he announce what's going to happen in the next five or the next five years. or six days, you see. And then they napt after that. The benediction. No. Then he out.
He's talking about a regular Sunday church service now.
No, I mean at a funeral.
They announce what's going to happen in the next five or six days at a funeral?
Oh, no. You said about the church, you see.
Yeah, well I meant at the church at a funeral.

Oh, no, no. They don't do that. Yeah. You're living at the funeral, no. When they finish preaching at church, all they're doing in the picture, when they finish, they dismiss the church and then they bring the body on that.
But I thought maybe some members of the congregation would speak or they'd come up and view the body or something.

Oh, well, before they leave the church, you see, when they fixin' to leave the church, they tell you, come around and view the body. And then you come around and view the body, and as you view the body, you come on up. You see? Wow. And then after you view the body, then on the church, close the body and then you catch it up. And then they come on up.
Do they open up the whole lid or do they have a half a lid or what on those colors?
They got a half lid there. You can see the face and everything. We're down there. Time to around the stomach.
Yeah, sure. Yeah, that's the way it's been when I've seen them.
I just read it now.
Do they have flowers with the body in the church or not?
Yeah, you do have flowers in the church.
Any other kind of decoration or anything with the body?
No, no more than flowers and bouquet of flowers and a wreath, what I'll say, you can see, designed.
Well, now, how would the body be dressed?
Well, that's up to the family, you see. They choose what kind of garment that they want to put on the folks, you see. It's up to them. And they can put anything you want on.
Well, what do they usually have, though?
Well, if you're a man, if you have your own suit, if you want them to put that on, you're sorry. But if you want to get a suit from the undertaker, well, they put that on you. See?
Would it be a regular suit or a tuxedo or what?
Well, you just, any kind of stuff you want, you just depend on that.
I see. Now, suppose he's a member of an organization. Would he have any of that uniform on?
Well, no. If they want to, they can put it on. But it's up to the family, you understand, what they want to put on. There's the bosses leaving.
I see.
Well, do the Masons ever hire a band of music for their funerals?
Sometimes. Yes.
Because they always seem to have pretty much ceremony in themselves. I mean, you know.
Yes, yes. They are.
